source.title: Northern Whig, 6 June 1930, p. 7 ("Fermanagh elections")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and votes read on the page image of the Northern Whig results of 6 June 1930 and checked against the Belfast News-Letter of the same date

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Three contests, Castlebalfour, Lisnaskea and Ballindarragh; the Unionists won all three. The uncontested divisions are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Noble (U.) 111; Hogan (N.) 81; Unionist majority 30.
